book.name: Jadjis
book.title: Jadjis Ola Lida Blanga Isreil Bifo Deibin Abum Eni King

content: Bambai na wen imbin taim blanga gajimbat ola sid daga en pudum langa haus, Semsan bin gajim lilwan gout, en imbin go blanga luk im waif, en wen imbin kamat langa im kemp, imbin dalim im lambarra, “Ai wandi go langa main waif rum.” Bat im lambarra nomo bin larram im,
en imbin tok, “Aibin reken yu nomo bin laigim im, en aibin gibit im langa yu fren. Bat im lilwan sista iya im mowa purdibala langa im, en yu gin abum im.”
Wal wen im lambarra bin tok lagijat, Semsan bin tok, “Wal nobodi kaan pudum bleim langa mi blanga wanim ai garra dumbat langa ol yumob Filastain pipul!”
Brom deya Semsan bin go, en imbin gajim 300 wailwan dog gulum foks, en imbin taiyimap wanbala faiyastik langa dubala dog teil olawei garram detlot 300 dog,
en afta imbin larram go ol detlot dog langa ola fam blanga detlot Filastain pipul, en detlot faiyastik bin barnimap ola sid daga en ola frut daga deya langa ol detlot fam ebriweya langa det kantri.

Wal ol detlot Filastain pipul bin askimbat miselp hubin barnimap olabat fam, en deibin faindat Semsan bin dum, dumaji im lambarra bin gibit im waif langa najawan men deya langa det taun gulum Timna. Afta na detlot pipul bin go langa det taun, en deibin barnimap det gel en im dedi haus.
Wal wen deibin barnimap det gel en im dedi haus, Semsan bin gitwail, en imbin dalim olabat, “Yumob bin dum brabli nogudbala ting tharran. En ai dalim yumob. Ai kaan stap raidap ai peiyimbek yumob.”
En imbin go en fait langa olabat, en imbin kilim bigismob ded, en afta imbin go en jidan langa wanbala keib deya langa det hil kantri gulum Itam.
Brom deya ol detlot Filastain pipul bin kaman en kemp langa det kantri blanga Juda klen, en deibin meigim miselp redibala blanga fait langa ola Isreil pipul deya langa det taun gulum Leihi.

Wal ola men brom Juda klen bin go en askim detlot Filastain pipul, “Wotfo yumob bin kaman blanga fait langa melabat?” En detlot pipul bin tok, “Melabat bin kaman blanga gajim Semsan en tridim im seimwei laik imbin tridim melabat.”

Wal wen deibin tok lagijat, 3,000 men brom Juda klen bin go langa det keib blanga lukabat Semsan, en wen deibin faindim im, deibin tok, “Wanim yu dumbat langa melabat? Yu sabi detlot Filastain pipul jidan bos blanga melabat?” Wal Semsan bin tok, “Aibin tridim olabat seimwei laik deibin tridim mi.”

Wal detlot men bin tok, “Wal melabat bin kaman iya blanga gajim yu en taiyimap yu en deigimbek yu langa detlot Filastain pipul.” Wal Semsan bin tok, “Wal yumob meigim pramis garram mi yumob kaan kilim mi ded.”
En deibin tok, “Yuwai. Melabat kaan kilim yu. Melabat garra taiyimap yu en hendimoba yu langa detlot pipul.” Wal deibin taiyimap Semsan garram dubala nyuwan roup, en deibin godan brom det hil,

en wen deibin kaman gulijap langa det taun, ola Filastain pipul bin jingat, en deibin ran blanga midim olabat langa det roud, en streidawei det spirit blanga YAWEI det trubala God bin meigim Semsan strongbala, en imbin breigim det dubala roup weya deibin taiyimap im dubala am jis laik samting bin meltimap det roup,
en imbin faindim dongki jauboun deya, en imbin gajim det jauboun, en imbin kilim 1,000 Filastain men ded deya gin garram det jauboun,
en afta imbin sing dijan song.

content.text: Garram jauboun aibin meigim olabat leidan ebriweya.”

content: Brom deya Semsan bin tjakidawei det jauboun, en deibin gibit det pleis najawan neim. Deibin gulum det pleis Jauboun Hil. Bat garram det Hibru langgus deibin gulum Remaleihai.

Wal afta na Semsan bin brabli thesti blanga woda, en imbin jingat langa YAWEI, “Yubin meigim mi bidim detlot Filastain pipul. Bat mi gulijap dai blanga woda na. Wal yu kaan larram mi dai. Bambai detlot Filastain pipul grebum mi.”

Wal wen Semsan bin jingat langa im lagijat, God bin irrim im, en imbin opinim det graun deya gin langa det taun gulum Leihi, en woda bin kamat, en Semsan bin dringgim det woda raidap imbin sedisfaid, en imbin filim miselp strongbala. Wal deibin gulum det neim blanga det wodapleis Jingat. Bat garram det Hibru langgus deibin gulum Heikori. En det wodapleis im stil deya tudei.
Wal afta na nomeda detlot Filastain pipul bin kipgon jidanbat bos blanga detlot Isreil pipul, bat stil Semsan bin jidan lida blanga olabat fo 20 yiya.
